data.name: DIESELDOME: Ultraviolent Gladiator Shooter
data.detailed_description:
WE WHO ARE ABOUT TO DIE SALUTE YOU! 

Enter the DOME, a fast paced, retro roguelike FPS with movement shooter mechanics. The DOME is ready for your BLOOD - Prepare to rip and tear your way through the arena. You're not here to survive. You're here to become a LEGEND.

BECOME AN UNSTOPPABLE GLADIATOR OF DESTRUCTION

Strap into DIESELDOME - a Roman-punk hellhole where the only law is fuel, and the only exit is glory. Every run, you forge yourself into something the Empire has never seen before. Something worse.

Will you go full gas-powered berserker - raining down homing explosives like a one-man apocalypse? Or become the cold, calculating V8-powered crossbow sniper who wall-runs through the carnage and slides between corpses like death itself on a lunch break?

  • Multiple warriors of ruin, each packing their own weapons, abilities, and progression trees built for one purpose: maximum devastation.

  • 70+ game-breaking perks that stack, synergize, and combine into builds so powerful, they should probably be illegal.

THE CROWD IS YOUR JUDGE. YOUR JURY. YOUR FUEL.

In the DIESELDOME, 50,000 screaming animals in the crowd hold your fate in their grease-stained hands. Give them a SHOW. Master the combo system, paint the arena red, and watch your popularity rise with every roaring ovation.

  • Unlock new skill trees, maps, and passive abilities through randomized bets — because fortune favors the savage.

  • No two runs, nor any two massacres are ever the same thanks to the randomized in-game event system

  • Face 10+ boss abominations built like nightmares and tuned like muscle cars.

And if you become the ultimate gladiator? They say Caesar himself is waiting for you. He's been waiting a long time.

A BRUTAL ROGUELITE TOURNAMENT MODE

Tournament Mode throws you into a procedurally generated meat grinder disguised as a gladiator tournament. Every fight comes stitched together from fresh insanity: new objectives, new modifiers, risky bets, new side events, new ways to die screaming.

One fight might turn you into a wall-running execution machine carving through hordes at terminal velocity.

The next might lock you in a steel coffin with flaming psychopaths and call it “sport.”

Complete side objectives for Caesar Chests packed with relics, gamble your earnings for Oil and rewards powerful enough to get outlawed by three separate empires. Trade perks. Break builds. Become a gas powered problem nobody knows how to solve anymore.

After completing a bracket you can cash out and crawl back to the Ludus with your pockets full of Oil and most of your organs still attached.

Or keep going.

Push deeper into the tournament where the crowds scream louder, the challengers get meaner, and every arena starts feeling less like a competition and more like a public execution with sponsorships.

The Empire doesn't remember the cautious.

It remembers the maniacs who kept going.

PARKOUR OR PERISH. THERE IS NO IN-BETWEEN.

Your body is not flesh. Your body is a V8 engine WRAPPED in flesh. Wall-run. Slide. Grapple. Glide. Move like the arena's trying to kill you - because it is.

The Dome's machinery never sleeps. Platforms shift. Arenas reconfigure. The challenge evolves. Only the worthy find a way through.

Master the movement, and you won't just survive the Dome. You'll own it.

Features 

  • Different playable characters, each with unique weapons, abilities, and progression trees.

  • Over 70 unique game-changing perks that can be synergized to devastate the Dome.

  • Unlock new skill trees, characters, maps, and passive skills while taking randomly generated bets.

  • Encounter randomized events and goals, making every match a fresh, unique challenge.

  • Face over 10 abominations and bloodthirsty bosses with unique move sets. They say Caesar himself awaits those who become the ultimate gladiator.

  • Parkour your way to glory by wall-running, sliding, grapple-hooking, gliding, and more.

  • Encounter unique mini-quests while in a run, such as marksmanship challenges and races, and win unique rewards by opening Caesar Chests.

  • A tutorial level that introduces the world and gameplay of DIESELDOME.

  • Unique collectible power-ups that turn you into a god for a short time.

data.short_description: DIESELDOME is an ultra-violent Roguelite FPS that fuses movement shooter combat with Survivors-like mechanics. Enter a brutal tournament, shred endless hordes, gamble your gold, bet your blood, and break the game with absurd power for the entertainment of a ruthless Roman-punk crowd.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.50 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: DieselDome contains extreme graphic violence including dismemberment, gore, and blood.
